title: Research provenance and Slumbot baseline integrity repair
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Capturing code paths, dirty patches, source manifests, artifact hashes, exact commands, automatic wall time, and current Standard10 baseline defaults will eliminate all repairable audit warnings and prevent future evidence/report contamination.
material_change: Replace stale -71.383 baseline defaults with -11.4275; make milestone text baseline-agnostic; extend experiment_log with patch/source/artifact SHA256 provenance, exact-command audits, automatic wall time, and provenance auditing; truthfully retrofit 12 recent records.
baseline: Pre-repair audit: 12 post-cleanup experiment records had 97 warnings; Slumbot report defaults used obsolete -71.383 bb/100 baseline.
notes: All 36 remaining warnings are three truthful historical gaps per pre-repair record: no start-time dirty patch, no start-time source manifest, and at least one descriptive/placeholder command. No repairable wall-time, artifact-integrity, or evaluation-accounting warning remains.

result.summary: Updated the active Slumbot baseline default to Standard10 -11.4275 bb/100 and reduced the 12-record audit from 97 warnings to 36 documented, irrecoverable historical provenance gaps; all repairable warnings are gone.
result.conclusion: The new logger captures exact commands, restricted dirty patches, source manifests, artifact SHA256/size, and automatic wall time for future runs. Seven tests and the 52-record validator pass. Historical provenance gaps remain explicit rather than being backfilled with fabricated evidence.
result.next_step: Use the repaired logging contract for the next learned-policy experiment; require exact command and code paths at start, then update accounting from every generated evidence bundle.
